analysis_definition.primary: Within each block log ratio of arithmetic average of 2 candidate run means to arithmetic average of 2 baseline run means. Across blocks equal weight to six input strata. Variance estimated separately per input, Welch-Satterthwaite t degrees of freedom. Independent experimental units are four-run blocks, not individual hops.
analysis_definition.ci: alpha=.05/4=.0125, individual98.75% with >=95% simultaneous coverage by Bonferroni for2models x2conditions. Speedup and reduction are monotone transforms of the same underlying ratio.
analysis_definition.bootstrap: 20000 within-input whole-block resamples; secondary circular chronological whole-block residual bootstrap length4/8, input effects removed and held fixed,20k. HAC Bartlett lag3 with N/(N-6) correction; normal critical value.
analysis_definition.randomization: 100000 balanced ABBA/BAAB assignments within each input; fixed center/outer contrast; p=(extreme+1)/(100001), no effect-based stopping.
analysis_definition.variance_descriptions: SD of run means includes between-input differences and all disturbances. SD of paired block log ratios and ms differences plus within-input pooled SD and stratified SE reported. Pooled-hop SD/quantiles are descriptive only.
analysis_definition.quarters: Equal input-weighted effects within chronological quarters; descriptive, no independent significance claims.
analysis_definition.selfcheck: Known mean,variance,df,tcritical,ratio transforms,and zero variance passed.
analysis_definition.arithmetic: Global arithmetic mean ratio descriptive; primary paired geometric estimate may differ. No historical measurements pooled.
